■ Stage Direction
SE: Roaring Cheers

Seeing girls giving it everything they've got gave so many people
courage and cheered them up so much, and that's when I understood...!
(WAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!)
Really?!

And!!
Please be my Trainer!!

The Umamusume who wins gives everyone watching
so much inspiration, hope, and dreams, right?!
(WAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH...!!)

Waaah, the favorite is coming from way on the outside?!
Can she go all the way like that?! Can she really pull it off?!

"A 'Derby Umamusume' is someone
who makes everyone's dreams come true!" That's what they said!

Winning Ticket's absolute sincerity had come through loud and clear
from everything we'd shared so far...

Whoa, look at number 5's closing kick!!
Ahhh, but number 11 is charging from behind too...!!

Still, running into my fellow ant buddy in a place like this!
I'm so suuuuper happy!!
They're off to an even start!!

—GOOOOOOOOAL!!
The pinnacle of Umamusume has now!! Been decided—!!

Because of all that, racing was always my biggest dream from the start,
but...

Just like those girls I saw on TV back then!! Just like the girls
I watched from the stands that day!! Just like the ones standing out there today!!

WHAAAAT?!?!?!?!?
W-W-W-W-Wonderful?!

...Wait, but first, I gotta find a Trainer to take charge of me
and make my debut... though...

W-WAAAAAAAHHHHHHH!!!!
I'M ZO MOOOOVED!!!!

You think so? Ehehe... Ehehehehe~!
...Hauhh, I'm getting all fuzzy and itchy! Scratchy scratch...
I JUST!! REALIZED!!!!

Knowing how she feels, turning her down...
is something I cannot do as a Trainer!

W-W-Wait, ant buddy!!
That!! Badge on your lapel!! Could it be...
I realized this place was super "special"!!
The Nippon Derby is about to get underway!!

Nnnnghhhh... YEEEEEEEEEESSSSSSSS...!!
WE DID IIIIIIIIITTTTTTTT!!

SHE DID IIIIIIIIIIIT!!
Amazing... Everyone worked... so haaaard...

—And the day has finally arrived!
Which Umamusume will seize the crown and show us a brand new dream?!
WHAAAAAAAAT?!

And then, the fans around me told me!
"The Derby is packed full of dreams," they said!

WOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!
Go for it, everyone! DO YOUR BEEEEEEST!!

Precisely because the Derby is said to be even tougher
than becoming someone that incredible—

It's just... so incredible...!
I'm always, always so moved... *sniff*...!

One day, I went to watch a race with my family!!
—The Nippon Derby!!
Whoa!! It's almost post time...!!

Someday, I'm definitely gonna become a Derby Umamusume
who can give everyone dreams to believe in, toooooo!!
You were a Trainer?!

A 2,400-meter turf race. One leg of the Twinkle Series
Classic Triple Crown, and—

...Phew! I'm okay!!
Ehehe, remembering how I felt back then just got to me!

Thank you, Trainer! Thank you sooo much!!
Really... really... *sniff*...!!

"Becoming the Trainer of a Derby-winning Umamusume
is harder than becoming Prime Minister of a nation."

Please, please, pleeease...! I waaant, waaaant, WANT to become
a Derby Umamusume no matter whaaat!

At first, I only watched it on TV,
but even then, the crowd's energy reached right through to me!

Still, thank you so much!!
I'm gonna do my absolute best toward my dream!!
Well, of course!!

It took a while... no, quite a long while,
for an overjoyed Winning Ticket to finally stop crying.

The Derby is just so awesome after all...!
Uuuugh, I wanna run here as soon as I caaaan!!

Of course I was there!!
I mean, it's the Derby! There's no way I'd miss it!!

I've been playing all kinds of sports ever since I was little,
but discovering racing was truly something special!

The power and the heat were just insane! Even though I was tiny
and knew nothing about racing yet, it was obvious to me!
Now, carrying the dreams of everyone involved in this race, right now—

The runners round the fourth corner!
Here comes the fateful final straight!!

Thank you so, so muuuuch!
WAAAAAAHHHHHH!!
That's why I'm gonna take the Derby!!

The Nippon Derby... A special race for Umamusume,
Trainers, and fans alike.

I don't really get what a "Prime Minister" is,
but it's gotta be someone super incredible, right?

Phew, *sniff*...
That was seriously such an amazing race!!
